settings.source: FP16 package precision and screened options; FP32 uses current ORTSoVITS defaults

process.source_scope: Benchmark records hashes of runtime files at start and detects changes during the run. Worker ready metadata independently identifies interpreter, PID, package and sessions; it does not include a separate worker source-hash map.
process.close_scope: Recorded process tree and pool state, not zero driver or whole-card VRAM.

fast-natural-timing.timing_scope: Host original-text submission through complete PCM return, including transfers and any model reload. WAV and JSON disk writes excluded. Background memory sampling disabled.

settings.source: FP16 package precision and screened options; FP32 uses current ORTSoVITS defaults

process.source_scope: Benchmark records hashes of runtime files at start and detects changes during the run. Worker ready metadata independently identifies interpreter, PID, package and sessions; it does not include a separate worker source-hash map.
process.close_scope: Recorded process tree and pool state, not zero driver or whole-card VRAM.

memory.scope: Sampled whole-device nvidia-smi memory, including desktop and other processes. Peak minus actual first sample is not exclusive process VRAM; 100 ms sampling may miss transient peaks. CPU tree RSS may double-count shared pages.

fast-natural-memory.timing_scope: Host original-text submission through complete PCM return, including transfers and any model reload. WAV and JSON disk writes excluded. Background memory sampling active.

timing_memory_pair.scope: Separate memory and timing runs; sampler-run latency is excluded.

fresh_performance.scope: Fresh numpy.default_rng seed1234 with no official replay. Timing excludes the background memory sampler and ends at complete PCM return. Memory is whole-card sampling, not process-exclusive VRAM. No quality gate is inferred.

metric_scope: Unicode NFKC, remove Unicode punctuation categories P* and whitespace, then unit-cost character Levenshtein. No kana conversion, homophone substitution, target-conditioned correction or rewriting. Character differences, including kanji/kana spelling, are not proof of missing or mispronounced speech.
limits: ASR is auxiliary content evidence, not human listening, speaker identity, tone or naturalness acceptance.
One seed and one selected hot output for four Japanese texts per configuration; no multilingual or robustness claim.
ASR segment timestamps are unmodified decoder output, not phoneme or word alignment.
Reference and candidate text equality cannot establish that either generated all requested speech.
The FP32 replay pair and natural FP16 pair use different random-input mechanisms and generate different semantic sequences; cross-family differences cannot isolate GPT precision effects.
Candidate strict official-FP32 PCM failures are preserved in original TTS reports and are not waived by ASR text agreement.
